result.title: Learning from Natural Images Untangles Number Sense
result.summary: Numerical cognition is a simple yet fundamental ability that remains challenging for modern vision-language models. Meanwhile, number sense is already present in numerically naïve animals, suggesting that it can emerge without explicit numerical learning. Deep neural networks provide a related observation, with numerosity-selective units appearing after training on unrelated natural-image tasks and even before any training. However, these findings leave unresolved whether visual learning contributes beyond the spontaneous emergence of numerical selectivity. Human development provides a clue, as children become better at making judgments in which numerosity and proportion conflict. Here, we introduce a geometric framework to trace how representations of these two quantities change across learning. Although untrained and pretrained networks exhibited similar unit-level numerosity selectivity and basic comparison performance, natural-image pretraining increased the angle between numerosity and proportion subspaces while reducing their overlap, supporting more robust readout under conflict. Direct manipulation of these geometric properties further demonstrated their functional contributions to decoding accuracy and functional independence. Importantly, conventional supervised pretraining was not essential for quantity separation, which also emerged through self-supervised learning without category labels and synthetic-image training without natural-image exposure. Together, our findings suggest that structured visual learning can refine spontaneously emerging number sense into robust and functionally independent quantity representations without explicit numerical training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个几何框架，追踪视觉网络中「数值」与「比例」两种量表征在学习前后的变化，发现自然图像预训练虽未提升单元级选择性与基本比较能力，却增大了两个子空间的夹角并减少重叠，使冲突情境下的读出更稳健；直接操纵这些几何性质进一步验证了其对解码准确性与功能独立性的作用，且自监督与合成图像训练也能产生类似的量分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 其子空间夹角与重叠度量可供核查：是否可用来判断 latent 推理状态中任务必要信息（如数值、空间细节）与干扰因素的分离程度，从而支撑「表示保留」与功能独立性评价；但该文聚焦视觉编码器的量表征，未涉及推理期状态生成或证据筛选，迁移属推测。
